resources.string: Press and hold an app to change it
Everything the mode changed will be put back the way it was, including your home screen and apps.
%1$d apps · tap one to add it to this slot
Choose what the mode does. Anything you switch off is left untouched.
Options could not be read. Make sure the module is installed and the phone is rooted, then press Refresh.
Checking every option. This takes about five minutes — leave the phone alone until it finishes.
Check what works on this phone

Each option will be applied, tested on the phone and then put back, one after another. This takes about five minutes. Leave the phone alone with the screen off while it runs — the mode is switched off for the test and stays off afterwards.\n\nThe result is saved to /data/adb/spsm/state/probe.tsv and shown under each option.
Check finished · %1$s working · %2$s nothing to do · %3$s could not check
a setting, not a device change
Saved. This will not be applied while the mode is off.
That option was not recognised by the module. Update the module and try again.
Super Power Saving needs the module installed and root access to work. Once it is set up, this app only shows the options and the power-mode home screen.
The module is not installed. Install it from Magisk or KernelSU, then reboot.
Root access was refused. Grant this app root, then check again.
Your home screen and the options you chose will change until you turn the mode off.
Everything will be put back the way it was.
Super Power Saving is off. Everything has been restored.
The mode could not be switched on. Check that the module is installed and root is granted.
Root is needed to switch this mode on.
Your six apps stay available while the mode is on. Everything else can be paused.
You can also switch the mode on from the quick settings tile.
Choose the six apps you still need while the mode is on.
Run the module once and this screen will not appear again.
This app needs the module installed and root access to switch the mode on.
